title: Demand Service Rate Programs: The Allowance for Settling a Demand Service Account
content:
| The most recent invoice on the program | Payments received on the program within the 24-month ledger window | The allowance on the charges taken in |
|---|---|---|
| fell due no longer ago than the tier's suspension period | some stand received | 1.5 percent |
| fell due longer ago than the tier's suspension period | some stand received | 0.5 of that allowance, which is 0.75 percent |
| any | none stands received | no allowance comes off |

The suspension period the first column is measured against, by program under the Demand Service Rate Programs:

| Program | Suspension period (calendar days past due) |
|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 45 |
| Priority Response Program | 45 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 45 |
| Emergency Response Program | 30 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 30 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 30 |

**Both sides of the period (hypothetical).** On the Emergency Response Program, whose suspension period
is 30 calendar days, an account whose most recent invoice fell due 30 days ago, with payments standing
received inside the ledger window, carries the allowance of 1.5 percent, 30 days being no longer ago
than the period; where that invoice fell due 31 days ago the allowance stands at 0.75 percent instead.
Where no payment at all was received on the program inside the ledger window, no allowance comes off,
however recently the invoice fell due.
